BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT QUOTATION_NO FROM KEPTBIT WHERE QUOTATION_NO = RTRIM($QUOTATION_NO$) AND SEQ = RTRIM($SEQ$) AND REVISION_NO = RTRIM($REVISION_NO$) ) BEGIN INSERT INTO KEPTBIT( STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, QUOTATION_NO, SEQ, REVISION_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO, UNIT_MEASURE, SELLER, SELLER_COMPANY_NAME, SELLER_NAME, SELLER_TEL, UNIT_PRICE, IF_FLAG )VALUES( RTRIM($STATUS$), RTRIM($ADD_DATE$), RTRIM($ADD_TIME$), RTRIM($QUOTATION_NO$), RTRIM($SEQ$), RTRIM($REVISION_NO$), RTRIM($BUYER_ITEM_NO$), RTRIM($UNIT_MEASURE$), RTRIM($SELLER$), RTRIM($SELLER_COMPANY_NAME$), RTRIM($SELLER_NAME$), RTRIM($SELLER_TEL$), CAST(ISNULL($UNIT_PRICE$,0) AS FLOAT), 'N' ) END
ELSE BEGIN UPDATE KEPTBIT SET STATUS = RTRIM($STATUS$), ADD_DATE = RTRIM($ADD_DATE$), ADD_TIME = RTRIM($ADD_TIME$), BUYER_ITEM_NO = RTRIM($BUYER_ITEM_NO$), UNIT_MEASURE = RTRIM($UNIT_MEASURE$), SELLER = RTRIM($SELLER$), SELLER_COMPANY_NAME = RTRIM($SELLER_COMPANY_NAME$), SELLER_NAME = RTRIM($SELLER_NAME$), SELLER_TEL = RTRIM($SELLER_TEL$), UNIT_PRICE = CAST(ISNULL($UNIT_PRICE$,0) AS FLOAT), SEND_REMARK = RTRIM($REMARK$), IF_FLAG = 'N' WHERE QUOTATION_NO = RTRIM($QUOTATION_NO$) AND SEQ = RTRIM($SEQ$) AND REVISION_NO = RTRIM($REVISION_NO$) END END
